column1: # XMage Class#method <TAB> known_bug reason (gorge divergence, file:line, CR).
# xmageport -commit writes a FAILING generated scenario only when it is listed
# here; TestXMagePortScenarios then skips it and fails once it passes (stale).

column2: B6: ChangeZoneAll GainControl$ moves the card under its OWNER and emits ControlChange only after the battlefield MoveZone (engine/effects/zone_changeall.go:248 then :271; same order in engine/effects/zone_change.go:1481), so Soul Snuffers' ETB trigger is controlled by its owner and Obelisk Spider ("you put") never triggers. CR 110.2a, 603.3a.

B6: ChangeZoneAll GainControl$ emits ControlChange after the battlefield MoveZone (engine/effects/zone_changeall.go:248 then :271), so the returned creatures' ETB triggers are controlled by their owner, and the owner's Obelisk Spider triggers instead of none. CR 110.2a, 603.3a.

B9: Mode$ BecomesTarget ignores FirstTime$ True (engine/rules/trigmatch/actions.go:234-307 never reads it), so Glyph Keeper counters every spell or ability that targets it, not only the first each turn. CR 603.2 (trigger condition as printed).

B10: DestroyAll ValidCards$ Card.blockedBySourceThisTurn matches nothing: engine/effects/filter_word.go:1471 knows only blockedBySource (live o.BlockedBy, :898-901), so Defiant Vanguard's end-of-combat delayed trigger destroys itself but not the creature it blocked.

B11: Token AtEOT$ ExileCombat is not implemented (engine/effects/ateot.go:37-52 emits a Note and keeps the token), so Geist of Saint Traft's Angel survives end of combat. CR 511.2 (delayed trigger at end of combat).

B13: one TokenAmount$ 2 creation fires Woodland Champion's Mode$ ChangesZoneAll line once PER token (engine/rules/trigger_match.go:1538 batches ChangesZoneAll only while e.zoneBatchOpen, which token creation never opens), and each per-event trigger reads TriggerCount$Amount as 0 (no TriggerAmount bound for the per-event ChangesZoneAll path in engine/rules/trigger_referents.go), so no counters are put. CR 603.2c (one batch event).

XP[effect-prevent-validtarget-ignores-remembered]: Shielded Passage's Effect-created bodyless Event$ DamageDone | Prevent$ True | ValidTarget$ Card.IsRemembered never prevents (probe: Passage then Lightning Bolt on own Rootwater Hunter still kills it), so Hunter dies to Alms Beast in combat and the post-combat activation is not offered. damageReplacementMatches evaluates ValidTarget$ with plain matchesSpecFrom, not the registration's remembered set (engine/rules/replacement_damage.go:326-328; ValidSource$ just above uses rememberedSpecContext). CR 615.1a.

XP[conditionmanaspent-unmodelled]: ConditionManaSpent$ is listed as unmodelled (engine/effects/condition_census.go:95), so the 'if {B}/{W} was spent' sub-abilities fail closed and Batwing Brume does nothing (engine/effects/conditions.go:72). CR 601.2h + Oracle. Secondary translation issue: tool pays {W/B} hybrid from a pool using the first colour, giving 'CW' instead of the Swamps' B (cmd/xmageport/build.go:386), so even with the engine fixed this test would get the W branch.

XP[conditionmanaspent-unmodelled]: ConditionManaSpent$ is unmodelled (engine/effects/condition_census.go:95) and fails closed, so the Fog half does not run even though W was paid ('Pay W' in transcript); p0 takes 2. CR 601.2h + Oracle. Secondary: pool 'CW' (build.go:386) never spends B, so the B-life-loss half could not match XMage (W+B from Plains+Swamp) either.

XP[player-istriggerremembered-unsupported]: Phytotitan's delayed trigger ValidPlayer$ Player.IsTriggerRemembered is never satisfied. MatchesPlayerSpecCtx handles only IsRemembered/Chosen (engine/effects/player_filter.go:221) and controlsCard.IsTriggerRemembered (:268), not a bare IsTriggerRemembered against pc.DelayedRemembered. The gate at engine/rules/trigger_delayed.go:227 fails closed, so Phytotitan stays in the graveyard (probe: still in GY at turn 3 draw). CR 603.7.

XP[shares-creature-type-reads-printed-face]: sharesCreatureTypeWith iterates the referent's PRINTED Face().Types (engine/effects/filter_attachment.go:564), so Mistform Ultimus (CDA every creature type) only 'shares' Illusion and Mutavault (animated, all creature types) shares nothing; Coat of Arms gives Ultimus +3 instead of +5 and Mutavault +0 (probes: Ultimus+Coat+Lord of Atlantis = 4/4 not 5/5; Mutavault+Coat+Ultimus = 2/2 not 3/3). Should read derived creature types. CR 205.3m, 702.73a, 613.1d.

XP[repl-destroy-regeneration-unsupported]: card-script gap, coverage gate flags Clergy[api:Regeneration,repl:Destroy,stat:CantRegenerate]; R:Event$ Destroy | Regeneration$ True has no replacement class (engine/rules/replacement.go:701 replacementEventKind has no Destroy event) and destruction only consumes Shield counters (engine/effects/regeneration.go:49), so Doom Blade destroys it (.cards/cardsfolder/c/clergy_of_the_holy_nimbus.txt). CR 701.19a, 614.8.

XP[copied-as-enters-choice-not-posed]: Clever Impersonator entering as a copy of Kindred Discovery never gets the copied 'As enters, choose a creature type' ask (no Thopter choose in transcript; Ornithopters draw nothing): entryETBChoice walks o.Face().Repls of the pre-copy face (engine/rules/cast_etbchoice.go:117) while the copy is applied only later by effClone at the re-emitted move, so the template's ETBReplacement:Other:ChooseCT is never offered. CR 614.12, 707.2.

XP[clone-into-aura-no-enchant-choice]: Copy Enchantment resolves as a non-Aura permanent spell and enters as a copy of Inferno Fist, but gorge never asks what the Aura enchants: nonCastAuraEntrant excludes entries from the stack and tests the PRINTED face (engine/rules/aura_entry.go:92 o.Zone==ZStack, :95 faceIsAura(o.Face())), and the enchant election runs before the clone election (engine/rules/cast_etbchoice.go:96). The unattached Aura copy then goes to the graveyard by SBA (count p1 graveyard Copy Enchantment=1, Silvercoat Lion 2/2). CR 303.4f (Aura entering other than by resolving as an Aura spell: controller chooses what it enchants), CR 707.2/706 copy; Copy Enchantment ruling. Translation side note: setChoice answers are attached to pass_to but harness copes.

XP[etb-clone-whitelist-missing-choicezone]: Echoing Deeps' DB$ Clone carries ChoiceZone$ Graveyard, which is not in the as-enters Clone whitelist (engine/effects/clone_params.go:279-282 cloneETBShapeKeys; gated at engine/rules/cast_etbchoice.go:165 etbCloneWhitelist), so gorge never offers the copy: probe with permanent-count asserts showed Echoing Deeps stays Echoing Deeps (count p0 battlefield Urza's Saga=0, Echoing Deeps=1). CR 707.9a/707.9b (copy with exceptions) + Echoing Deeps Oracle. Translation side issues too: assertType("Urza's Saga") binds the graveyard setup card p0:Urza's Saga (build.go:676/531, same as assert-ref-binds-setup-card-not-battlefield-permanent) and SubType.URZAS is titleEnum'd to "Urzas" not "Urza's" (build.go:516).

XP[splice-keyword-unimplemented]: Gorge never offers Evermind's Splice onto Arcane when Into the Fray is cast (transcript: cast with only target decision; hand ends at 1); K:Splice has no implementation anywhere in engine/rules/ engine/effects/ engine/cards/ (grep 'Splice' finds only RNG splice code), and Zada's CopyForEachCanTarget$ is also unread (see ZadaHedronGrinderBoost). Card: .cards/cardsfolder/e/evermind.txt K:Splice:Arcane:1 U. CR 702.47a (Splice), CR 707.10d. Translation side note: cast mana is only R (Into the Fray's cost); splice cost {1}{U} would also need to be supplied.

XP[copy-for-each-can-target-unread]: Zada's trigger body DB$ CopySpellAbility | CopyForEachCanTarget$ Creature.YouCtrl: the param is not read anywhere (no reader in engine/effects/copy.go effCopySpellAbility, engine/effects/copy.go:55; grep finds no 'CopyForEach'), so gorge makes a single copy keeping Zada as target -> Zada 9/9, Pillarfield Ox 2/4 without flying. Should create one copy per other creature the spell could target, each targeting a different one. CR 707.10d. Card: .cards/cardsfolder/z/zada_hedron_grinder.txt.

XP[clone-gain-this-trigger-lost]: After the turn-1 upkeep copy (Cryptoplasm -> Silvercoat Lion, GainThisAbility$ True) gorge poses NO upkeep trigger on turn 3: RunOracleScenarioJSON decisions list shows only attackers after setup, and snapshots at turn 3 upkeep/main have an empty stack, so the copy did not keep "this ability". The gained trigger is appended only when engine/effects/clone.go:484-489 finds the resolving SA inside a printed trigger's Effect chain by pointer identity (cloneChainContains, clone.go:649) and the fold appends of.Triggers[Amount-1] (engine/events/apply_copy.go:397-405); an index of -1 appends nothing -- most likely failure point (not single-stepped). CR 707.9b (copy 'except it has this ability'), Cryptoplasm Oracle. Translation side issue: the test has no actions, so all setChoice/addTarget are silently dropped by assignChoices (cmd/xmageport/translate.go:229, to==nil) -- turn 3's Craw Wurm target would be lost even with a fixed engine (fallback picks first target, Silvercoat Lion).

XP[prevent-rider-shieldeffecttarget-targeted]: PreventionSubAbility$ with ShieldEffectTarget$ Targeted (Test of Faith) is not the supported ParentTarget shape, so effPreventDamage Notes 'unimplemented' and drops the +1/+1 rider (engine/effects/prevent_damage.go:95-98); damage is prevented but 0 counters even without Doubling Season (probe). CR 615.5.

XP[selector-yourteamctrl-unsupported]: Pir's R:Event$ AddCounter | ValidCard$ Permanent.YourTeamCtrl -- 'YourTeamCtrl' has no evaluator anywhere in effects/rules (grep empty; ChooseCounter$ also unread), so Pir never applies (probe: cast Chandra with Pir gets 4 loyalty, want 5) (.cards/cardsfolder/p/pir_imaginative_rascal.txt, coverage gate does not flag it). CR 614.1a (in a two-player game 'your team' is just you, CR 810.2).

XP[selector-yourteamctrl-unsupported]: Pir never applies (Permanent.YourTeamCtrl unevaluated, see test_LoyaltyCounters_Pir); Chandra stays at 4 (want (4+1)*2=10). CR 614.1a, 616.1. Secondary: setup-placement-not-effect (Doubling Season's EffectOnly rejects the setup entry, engine/rules/replacement_match.go:691).

XP[selector-yourteamctrl-unsupported]: Pir never applies (Permanent.YourTeamCtrl unevaluated, see test_LoyaltyCounters_Pir); Chandra stays at 4 (want 4*2+1=9). CR 614.1a, 616.1. Secondary: setup-placement-not-effect (engine/rules/replacement_match.go:691).

XP[rememberdrawn-allreplaced-ignores-replacement-draws]: RememberDrawn$ AllReplaced is treated like True and excludes cards drawn by a replacement (engine/effects/draw.go:31-32 'replaced draws are not here'), so with Thought Reflection 2 cards are drawn but Remembered$Amount=1 and only Shock is discarded (hand 2, want 1). Oracle 'for each card drawn this way' counts the replacement draws. CR 614.6, 121.6.

XP[flicker-keeps-attachments]: gorge reuses the ObjID across zone changes; the Move fold clears only the moving object's own AttachedTo (engine/events/apply_zone.go:894), and the attachment SBA only checks the bearer's current zone (engine/rules/attach.go:115), so after Momentary Blink returns Darksteel Citadel within one resolution, Ensoul Artifact stays attached (also reproduced with Rancor on a blinked Grizzly Bears staying 4/2). CR 400.7, 704.5m.

XP[cast-provenance-survives-zone-change]: WasCastFromHandByYou returns the obj's latest PutOnStack ever (engine/rules/host_cast_ledger.go:203-211). Object ids survive zone changes, so the reanimated Scion (a new object) still reads 'cast from hand' and triggers again (4 Birds, want 2). CR 400.7 / 603.4.

XP[totalpt-filter-unsupported]: Wild Pair's ChangeType$ Creature.totalPT_EQX and SVar X:TriggeredCard$CardSumPT have no implementation anywhere in engine/effects/ or engine/rules/ (grep finds no 'totalPT'/'CardSumPT'). The search finds nothing (no pick is offered, only the shuffle ask). Card script .cards/cardsfolder/w/wild_pair.txt; Oracle text (search for a creature with the same total power and toughness). CR 701.23a.

XP[etb-clone-whitelist-missing-addtriggers]: Estrid's Invocation's DB$ Clone carries AddTriggers$/AddSVars$/AILogic$, none in the as-enters Clone whitelist (engine/effects/clone_params.go:279-282 cloneETBShapeKeys; engine/rules/cast_etbchoice.go:165), so no copy election is offered at all (transcript: cast, then the 'Feather of Flight' answers are unconsumed and Grizzly Bears stays 2/2). Even once offered, the Aura copy would hit clone-into-aura-no-enchant-choice (engine/rules/aura_entry.go:92-95). CR 707.9a/707.9b, CR 303.4f.

XP[cr305-7-land-type-set-keeps-triggers]: Flagstones enchanted by Spreading Seas (RemoveLandTypes$+AddType$ Island) still fires its dies trigger (trigger_optional Yes in transcript). The trigger walk drops printed triggers only for 'loses all abilities' (printedAbilitiesLost, engine/rules/trigger_match.go:1279 / engine/rules/abilityloss.go:275). CR 305.7 is applied only to statics (engine/rules/chars/types.go:541). CR 305.7 + 603.10a. Translation side-issue (optional-may-fallback-declines): the Ghost Quarter basic-land search falls back to [] (engine/rules/oracle_run.go:1192), so the expected Plains never arrives.

XP[effect-replacement-loses-chosencard]: the DB$ Effect's DamageDone replacement is registered with Remembered/ChosenNumber but no ChosenCard snapshot (engine/effects/effect.go:566-577; statics do snapshot via effectChosenSnapshot at :663), and Forcefield's DBCleanup ClearChosenCard wipes the source's choice, so ValidSource$ Card.ChosenCard never matches and no damage is prevented (p1 14, want 18). CR 615.1a, 615.7. (cause inferred from code; chooses were answered)

XP[mustattack-effectsource-planeswalker]: at the pinned gorge Gideon Jura's +2 Effect (RememberObjects$ DelayTriggerRemembered) captures no player (engine/effects/staticline.go effectRememberedPlayers has no DelayTriggerRemembered arm), so ValidCreature$ Creature.RememberedPlayerCtrl selects no creature, and MustAttack$ EffectSource is no reference engine/rules/combat/attack.go requirementDefender resolves, so Balduvian Bears is never required to attack Gideon Jura and Gideon keeps 8 loyalty (want 6). CR 508.1d, 506.3. Fixed on gorge wt/kernel-gorgebug3 c7d3f38ba (with d1bc316af's harness forcing); retire at the next pin bump.

XP[oracle-harness-required-attacker+rowan-effect-cleanup]: at the pinned gorge the Bears are Required (gorge 296c38b1a) but the oracle harness submits the scripted empty declaration, which validateAttackDeclaration refuses ('harness: submit attackers []'); XMage's game forces the attacker (CR 508.1d). Fixed on gorge wt/kernel-gorgebug3 d1bc316af. Past that, Rowan Kenrith's Effect is not exiled at p1's cleanup (its RemoveEffect trigger, registered 'Cleanup|DU=permanent|SB|VP=Player.IsRemembered', never fires), so the Bears attack again on p1's next turn: p0 16, want 18. CR 611.2a.

XP[from-anywhere-self-trigger-only-admits-hand-origin]: zoneGate admits a no-TriggerZones$ ChangesZone self-trigger only when From==Hand (engine/rules/trigger_zone_gate.go:84-88), so Ulamog's 'put into a graveyard from anywhere' trigger does not fire when milled from the library (probe: Thought Scour milling Ulamog leaves graveyard 2) and the graveyard is never shuffled back. CR 603.6a, 603.10a. (Grindstone also did not repeat; not investigated.)

XP[moved-replacement-skips-token-creation]: TokenCreate maps only to the CreateToken replacement class (engine/rules/replacement.go:727-728), so Hallowed Moonlight's Event$ Moved | Destination$ Battlefield | Creature.!wasCast replacement never sees a token entering and the Spirit token stays (Reanimate's Ox is exiled correctly). CR 111.1, 614.1c, 614.12 (Hallowed Moonlight ruling: a token that would be created is exiled instead).

XP[condition-mana-spent-unmodelled]: ConditionManaSpent$/ConditionManaNotSpent$ are classified unmodelled and fail CLOSED (engine/effects/condition_census.go:95,99), so neither of Vigor Mortis's branches runs and Silvercoat Lion never returns (probe: BBBB and GGBB both fail, Zombify works) (.cards/cardsfolder/v/vigor_mortis.txt). CR 601.2h, 608.2c. Secondary (translation): the tool pays generic as C (cmd/xmageport/build.go:377), so {G} would not be 'spent' though XMage pays from Forests.

XP[harms-way-replacesplitdamage-unsupported]: card-script gap, coverage gate flags Harm's Way[api:ReplaceSplitDamage] (SVar SplitDamage DB$ ReplaceSplitDamage, .cards/cardsfolder/h/harms_way.txt); the DB$ Effect's ValidTgts$ Any target is also not posed at cast (step's target unused; it is asked at resolution). CR 614.9, 601.2c.

XP[harms-way-replacesplitdamage-unsupported]: same as testNoRedirectLavaBurst: api:ReplaceSplitDamage unsupported (.cards/cardsfolder/h/harms_way.txt SVar SplitDamage; no handler in engine/effects/) and the Effect sub-ability target is not posed at cast (unused target p1). CR 614.9, 601.2c.

XP[harms-way-replacesplitdamage-unsupported]: same as testNoRedirectLavaBurst: api:ReplaceSplitDamage unsupported (.cards/cardsfolder/h/harms_way.txt SVar SplitDamage; no handler in engine/effects/) and the Effect sub-ability target is not posed at cast (unused target p0:Silvercoat Lion). CR 614.9, 601.2c.

XP[harms-way-replacesplitdamage-unsupported]: same as testNoRedirectLavaBurst: api:ReplaceSplitDamage unsupported (.cards/cardsfolder/h/harms_way.txt SVar SplitDamage; no handler in engine/effects/) and the Effect sub-ability target is not posed at cast (unused target p1). CR 614.9, 601.2c.

XP[harms-way-replacesplitdamage-unsupported]: same as testNoRedirectLavaBurst: api:ReplaceSplitDamage unsupported (.cards/cardsfolder/h/harms_way.txt SVar SplitDamage; no handler in engine/effects/) and the Effect sub-ability target is not posed at cast (unused target p0; resolution posed 'choose -> a'). CR 614.9, 601.2c.

XP[effect-trigger-registers-ctx-remembered]: the Effect trigger registration uses regIDs := c.Remembered (the resolving spell's memory, empty), not the Effect's own RememberObjects$ Targeted set remembered, except in comeback/forget variants (engine/effects/effect.go:414-420). The DamageDone Creature.IsRemembered gate then never matches; a probe with a main-phase cast also draws 0. CR 603.2 + Oracle 'whenever that creature deals combat damage'.

XP[clone-setpt-not-copiable]: Primal Clay's as-enters choice is DB$ Clone Defined$ Self SetPower$/SetToughness$, which effClone registers as a separate layer-7b P/T effect (engine/effects/clone.go:591-596) instead of folding it into the copiable values, so Identity Thief copying Primal Clay gets printed */* = 0/0 and dies to SBA (probe: Identity Thief in p1 graveyard). CR 707.2 (as-enters P/T choices are copiable) / CR 707.9b. Secondary translation issue: assertPowerToughness(playerB,"Primal Clay") is mapped to p0's card ref because assertRef falls back to the other seat's card (cmd/xmageport/build.go:546) -- should be a seat-scoped battlefield-name P/T check.

XP[static-true-changeszone-trigger-on-stack]: Infinite Reflection's Static$ True ChangesZone trigger (RememberInitialAttach) is queued as an ordinary stacked trigger and offered in a trigger_order with TrigClone; ordered first it resolves last, so TrigClone resolves with an empty Remembered set, Silvercoat Lion stops being a creature/dies and Reflection goes to the graveyard (probe: Lion and Reflection in graveyard, Ox not a copy). checkFaceTriggers queues every matching T: line and only Attached/RolledDie matchers honour Static$ True (engine/rules/trigger_match.go:1147; engine/rules/trigmatch/actions.go:179,561). Static$ True lines must apply immediately, not use the stack. CR 603.3 (only real triggered abilities are put on the stack; Forge Static$ True lines are rules-engine bookkeeping that must apply immediately).

XP[effect-lifereduced-replacement-unregistered]: Angel's Grace's SP$ Effect ReplacementEffects$ SelflessDamage (Event$ LifeReduced with ReplaceWith$ ReduceLoss body) is never registered: engine/effects/effect.go:560-565 only registers bodied effect replacements for DamageDone/Moved/CreateToken/AddCounter, and engine/rules/replacement_life.go:159-162 only scans bodiless Prevent$ effect replacements. p0 took 20 combat + 3 Bolt to -3 (probe), survived turn 2 only via can't-lose, then lost on turn 3 -> 'game stopped'. CR 614.1a / Angel's Grace Oracle.

XP[trig-mode-destroyed-unsupported]: Karmic Justice's T:Mode$ Destroyed has no trigger mode in gorge (absent from triggerModeNames; coverage gate reports Karmic Justice[trig:Destroyed]), so the trigger never fires (engine/cards/linemodes.go:147; .cards/cardsfolder/k/karmic_justice.txt T:Mode$ Destroyed). CR 701.8 / 603.10a.

XP[trig-mode-destroyed-unsupported]: same as testFirstTriggeredAbility -- Mode$ Destroyed unsupported, no trigger for any of the destroyed noncreature permanents (engine/cards/linemodes.go:147; .cards/cardsfolder/k/karmic_justice.txt). CR 701.8 / 603.10a.

XP[march-locked-set-strips-printed-creature]: lockedLayer4Types approximates CR 613.6 by deleting the sibling's AddTypes (Creature) from EVERY object's finished type list (engine/rules/chars/derive.go:776-789), so printed artifact creature Ornithopter is treated as a 'noncreature artifact' and gets March's MV P/T 0/0 and dies. CR 613.6.

XP[march-locked-set-strips-printed-creature]: same lockedLayer4Types approximation (engine/rules/chars/derive.go:776-789) strips 'Creature' from Alloy Myr's printed types, so March sets it to MV 3/3 instead of leaving it 2/2. CR 613.6.

XP[ownedby-player-dot-triggeredtarget-unrecognised]: Wrexial's ValidTgts$ Instant.OwnedBy Player.TriggeredTarget never matches: controlReferent only knows the bare ref TriggeredTarget (and Player.IsRemembered/NotedFor), not "Player.TriggeredTarget", so it fails closed (engine/effects/trigger_referents.go:317-339, keys at :680-692); the trigger has no legal target and is removed -- transcript shows combat damage (p1 15) but no trigger/target decision at all. CR 603.3d, 115.1.

XP[permanent-effect-ltb-trigger-killed-by-own-source-leaving]: the DB$ Effect (Duration$ Permanent, source on battlefield -> |SB) registers LeavesPlay (ChangesZone, ValidCard$ Card.EffectSource) as a delayed trigger, but checkEventDelayedTriggers first runs delayedRegistrationLive, which drops a SourceBattlefield registration once its source is off the battlefield -- i.e. the very event it waits for kills it. Probe: control is gained, Bolt kills Merieke, stack stays empty (engine/rules/trigger_delayed.go:88-90 and :379; engine/effects/effect.go:404-406). CR 603.10a / 603.6c.

XP[etb-repl-validcard-ignores-entering-statics]: the first Mimic's ETB counter replacement (ValidCard$ Creature.ChosenType+Other+YouCtrl) is matched against the second Mimic in its origin zone (engine/rules/replacement_match.go:253, matchesSpec on ev.Obj), without the entering permanent's own 'is the chosen type' static/its ETB choice, so the second Mimic (chosen Dwarf) gets no +1/+1 counter. CR 614.12.

XP[etb-repl-validcard-ignores-entering-statics]: Bramblewood Paragon's ETB replacement (ValidCard$ Creature.Warrior+YouCtrl+Other) checks Metallic Mimic without its chosen-type static (answer 'Warrior' was consumed, still 2/1) (engine/rules/replacement_match.go:253). CR 614.12.

XP[etb-clone-election-cast-only]: the 'may enter as a copy' election for K:ETBReplacement:Copy (Clone) is only recorded on cast (engine/events/apply_cast.go:276 sets ETBCloneChoiceValid); any other entry -- here the Mimic Vat CopyPermanent token of Clone -- hits effClone's 'unimplemented API' fallback (engine/effects/clone.go:65-76), no choice is posed, and the 0/0 token dies, so no p0 Silvercoat Lion. CR 614.1c/614.12 (an as-enters replacement applies however the permanent enters, including as a token copy). (Side note: the turn-3 'Silvercoat Lion' setChoice was consumed by p1's turn-2 attackers decision via kind 'any'.)

XP[copy-token-own-etb-replacement-not-collected]: the Mirrorworks token copy of Mox Diamond enters without its own "If CARDNAME would enter, you may discard a land" replacement being offered (transcript: only one discard ask; 2 Mox on battlefield, 1 Mountain in graveyard). foldCopyToken mints the token via AddObject in an untracked ZLibrary state not in any zone list (engine/events/apply_copy.go:224-231, engine/state/game.go:757), effCopyPermanent then emits its battlefield MoveZone (engine/effects/copypermanent.go:840), and the replacement-source scan only visits zone lists Library..Stack + Command (engine/rules/repl_zoneskip.go:281,303), so the entering token's own R: line is never collected. CR 614.12, 707.2 (copy token has Mox Diamond's replacement ability as it would exist on the battlefield).

XP[permanent-spec-zone-blind-in-changeszone]: ChangesZoneAll ValidCards$ Permanent.YouOwn+!token is matched against the live card already in the graveyard (non-LKI branch), and the bare Permanent base requires Zone==Battlefield when no zone context is given, so library->graveyard (mill) and hand->graveyard (discard) of permanent cards never match; only the battlefield death fires (probe: counters stay 5 after mill and after discard) (engine/rules/trigmatch/zone.go:171-175; engine/effects/filter_compiled.go:385-391). Also mill is not zone-batched (see Sidisi). CR 110.4a / 603.2.

XP[animate-staticabilities-mustattack-ignored]: Nettling Imp's AB$ Animate staticAbilities$ MustAttack is dropped -- registerAnimateStaticAbilities only accepts NoCleanupDamage, cost statics, CantSacrifice, CantBlockUnless, CantAttackUnless and notes "mode MustAttack is not implemented; ignored", so the Lion is not required to attack (probe: attack_required false after the ability resolved) (engine/effects/leavebattlefield.go:174-177). CR 508.1d.

XP[nettling-delayed-destroy-noop]: the DelayedTrigger (RememberObjects$ ParentTarget) does go on the stack at turn-2's end step (probe stack_size 1) but its TrigDestroy (Defined$ DelayTriggerRemembered, ConditionDefined$ DelayTriggerRemembered ConditionPresent$ Creature.!attackedThisTurn) resolves without destroying the tapped, non-attacking Lion; the loss is in the remembered capture/Defined chain (engine/effects/delayed_trigger.go:74-81 ParentTarget capture; engine/effects/context.go:920-933; engine/effects/conditions.go:689-691). Must-attack is also ignored (engine/effects/leavebattlefield.go:174). CR 603.7c / 701.8.

XP[etb-clone-whitelist-rejects-addtriggers-addsvars]: Phantasmal Image's "you may have it enter as a copy" election is never posed; its DB$ Clone body carries AddTriggers$/AddSVars$, which are outside cloneETBShapeKeys (engine/effects/clone_params.go:279; engine/rules/cast_etbchoice.go:535 etbCloneWhitelist), so effClone takes the 'unimplemented API Clone' fallback (engine/effects/clone.go:63-75) and the Image enters as a 0/0 Illusion and dies -> only 1 Lurebound Scarecrow.
